summary: Marex Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of its offering of U.S.$500 million perpetual subordinated resettable fixed rate notes. The notes were issued at a fixed rate of 7.7%, and proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including funding a tender offer for its outstanding U.S.$100 million 13.250% perpetual subordinated convertible notes and acquisitions. The offering was oversubscribed, with Barclays, Goldman Sachs, and Jefferies as joint bookrunners. The notes are expected to carry 100% equity credit from S&P post redomiciliation. This is a capital issuance, not a special situation event.
